notes:
TCC Website Features 0.11.0: pick sermon speakers from a list

- A Speakers box on each sermon, straight under Categories: tick everyone who
  spoke, choose the main speaker, add a new speaker without leaving the page.
- The website shows every speaker, main speaker first, for example
  "Tyler Lynde & Amy Lynde", on the sermon page, the cards, the Speaker filter
  and site search.
- The Author follows the main speaker when an Editor or Administrator saves.
- Posts > Sermon speakers fills in older sermons once from their typed names,
  with a preview, a list of sermons that need a person, and Undo.
- The new switch, Sermon speakers, starts off. Switch it on under TCC Website >
  Features, then run the fill-in.
- Also includes the 0.10.1 security fixes.
